collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A friend asks a villager to spend the whole day helping with a move, but the villager already promised to rest after a long week.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A friend asks (name1) to spend the whole day helping with a move, but the villager already promised to rest after a long week.

choices.label: Offer a Smaller Amount of Help.
Suggest Someone Else Who Is Free.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The friend understands and finds other help.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The friend is disappointed, but the friendship holds.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An hour of help is enough, and the friend is grateful.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The hour turns into most of the day, and the villager learns to set a firmer limit next time.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The other villager agrees, and the move goes smoothly.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Nobody else is free, but the friend decides to move another day.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The villager sorts the friend's things while sitting down, and the move goes faster.

d2__fx.name: Outcome D2
d2__fx.text: The friend prefers muscle to planning, and they laugh about it.

d2__text.name: Outcome D2
d2__text.text: The friend prefers muscle to planning, and they laugh about it.
